prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style educational asset graphic. A side-by-side lineup of three distinct small theropod eggs arranged neatly on a flat, neutral light-grey studio floor. Each egg is small-to-medium sized, highly asymmetrical, and elongated with a narrow, stretched appearance and subtle structural surface ridges. From left to right: 1) A biologically accurate live egg featuring a vibrant teal-blue base heavily covered in dense, detailed micro-speckles and splotches of dark reddish-brown. 2) A spectacularly mineralized pyritized fossil egg looking like heavy, solid, metallic dull-gold stone with a subtle glinting texture. 3) A silicified fossil egg appearing as a solid, sleek matte-black shale rock. A single fuzzy kiwi fruit is cut in half and placed on the far left next to the first egg for an intuitive size comparison. Background is a clean, solid empty light-grey studio setting. STUDIO_GROUNDED lighting with crisp, dark contact shadows directly underneath each object to give them a heavy physical weight. Perfectly centered 1:1 square composition, formatted as a square hero card with a strict 25% negative space buffer on all four outer boundaries. A single small black-and-white checkered scale bar spans horizontally across the bottom floor plane.
visual_logic: Presents three realistic variations of small theropod eggs—moving from complex, modern bird-like teal camouflage to incredible metallic pyrite and dark shale mineralizations—framed perfectly for a 1:1 mobile layout using a kiwi for scale.
style_notes: SQUARE_HERO_CARD, STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3. Ensure the aspect ratio is exactly 1:1. Only one horizontal scale bar at the very bottom edge. All items must stay within the central power-zone grid without touching the frame limits.
